instruction:
You are a mechanical engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-06 compressor and pneumatic system package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Compressed-air demand, receiver storage, motor, and feeder workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run external software or parse a real source pack.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-06-LH-03`
- Air demand table: `AIR-06-DEMAND-03`
- Compressor data sheet: `COMP-06-DATA-03`
- Receiver/storage schedule: `RECEIVER-06-STORAGE-03`
- Motor schedule: `MOTOR-06-SCHED-03`
- Feeder schedule: `FEEDER-06-480V-03`
- Compressed-air memo: `MEMO-06-AIR-03`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Connected air demand | {{ connected_air_demand_m3_min }} m3/min |
| Simultaneity factor | {{ simultaneity_factor }} |
| Leakage allowance | {{ leakage_allowance_fraction }} |
| Selected compressor capacity | {{ selected_compressor_capacity_m3_min }} m3/min |
| Receiver volume | {{ receiver_volume_m3 }} m3 |
| Receiver pressure band | {{ receiver_pressure_band_kpa }} kPa |
| Atmospheric pressure | {{ atmospheric_pressure_kpa_abs }} kPa abs |
| Compressor specific power | {{ compressor_specific_power_kw_per_m3_min }} kW per m3/min |
| Motor efficiency | {{ motor_efficiency }} |
| Selected motor size | {{ selected_motor_kw }} kW |
| Feeder voltage | {{ feeder_voltage_v }} V |
| Feeder length | {{ feeder_length_km }} km |
| Feeder resistance | {{ feeder_resistance_ohm_per_km }} ohm/km |
| Feeder reactance | {{ feeder_reactance_ohm_per_km }} ohm/km |
| Motor power factor | {{ motor_power_factor }} |
| Maximum voltage drop | {{ max_voltage_drop_percent }} % |
| Branch pressure loss | {{ branch_pressure_loss_kpa }} kPa |
| Maximum branch pressure loss | {{ max_branch_pressure_loss_kpa }} kPa |

## Calculation Rules

- Adjusted air demand equals `connected_air_demand_m3_min x simultaneity_factor x (1 + leakage_allowance_fraction)`.
- Compressor capacity margin equals selected compressor capacity minus adjusted demand.
- Receiver storage runtime equals `receiver_volume_m3 x receiver_pressure_band_kpa / atmospheric_pressure_kpa_abs / adjusted_air_demand_m3_min`.
- Compressor shaft power equals adjusted demand times compressor specific power.
- Motor input power equals compressor shaft power divided by motor efficiency.
- Motor size margin equals selected motor size minus motor input power.
- Feeder current uses three-phase apparent power from motor input and power factor.
- Feeder voltage drop percent uses conductor resistance, reactance, feeder length, motor power factor, and reactive factor.
- Pressure drop margin equals maximum branch pressure loss minus branch pressure loss.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when capacity, motor, voltage-drop, and pressure-loss margins are non-negative.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated modelling evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "adjusted_air_demand_m3_min": <numeric_value>,
  "compressor_capacity_margin_m3_min": <numeric_value>,
  "receiver_storage_runtime_min": <numeric_value>,
  "compressor_shaft_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "motor_input_power_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "motor_size_margin_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_current_a": <numeric_value>,
  "feeder_voltage_drop_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "voltage_drop_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "pressure_drop_margin_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-06 compressor and pneumatic system template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one air demand, compressor, receiver, motor, feeder, and branch-pressure source pack.

[meta]
name = "compressor-pneumatic-system-package"
description = "SSC-06 compressor and pneumatic system metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound compressor and pneumatic system metrics from a deterministic SSC-06 task-owned source pack. The template combines adjusted air demand, compressor capacity margin, receiver storage runtime, motor input and margin, feeder voltage drop, branch pressure margin, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "compressor-pneumatic"
standards = ["compressed-air demand workflow", "receiver storage workflow", "motor and feeder sizing workflow"]
tags = ["mechanical", "compressor", "pneumatic", "receiver", "motor", "feeder", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.connected_air_demand_m3_min]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/min"
description = "AIR-06-DEMAND-03 connected air demand"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.simultaneity_factor]
type = "float"
description = "AIR-06-DEMAND-03 simultaneity factor"
min = 0.72
max = 0.72

[params.leakage_allowance_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "AIR-06-DEMAND-03 leakage allowance"
min = 0.12
max = 0.12

[params.selected_compressor_capacity_m3_min]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/min"
description = "COMP-06-DATA-03 selected compressor capacity"
min = 18.5
max = 18.5

[params.receiver_volume_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "RECEIVER-06-STORAGE-03 receiver volume"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.receiver_pressure_band_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "RECEIVER-06-STORAGE-03 usable pressure band"
min = 150.0
max = 150.0

[params.atmospheric_pressure_kpa_abs]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa abs"
description = "RECEIVER-06-STORAGE-03 atmospheric pressure basis"
min = 101.3
max = 101.3

[params.compressor_specific_power_kw_per_m3_min]
type = "float"
unit = "kW per m3/min"
description = "COMP-06-DATA-03 specific power at operating pressure"
min = 6.2
max = 6.2

[params.motor_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "MOTOR-06-SCHED-03 motor efficiency"
min = 0.95
max = 0.95

[params.selected_motor_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "MOTOR-06-SCHED-03 selected motor size"
min = 110.0
max = 110.0

[params.feeder_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 feeder voltage"
min = 480.0
max = 480.0

[params.feeder_length_km]
type = "float"
unit = "km"
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 feeder length"
min = 0.18
max = 0.18

[params.feeder_resistance_ohm_per_km]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm/km"
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 conductor resistance"
min = 0.321
max = 0.321

[params.feeder_reactance_ohm_per_km]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm/km"
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 conductor reactance"
min = 0.081
max = 0.081

[params.motor_power_factor]
type = "float"
description = "MOTOR-06-SCHED-03 motor power factor"
min = 0.88
max = 0.88

[params.max_voltage_drop_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 maximum allowed voltage drop"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.branch_pressure_loss_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "AIR-06-DEMAND-03 branch pressure loss"
min = 22.0
max = 22.0

[params.max_branch_pressure_loss_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "COMP-06-DATA-03 maximum branch pressure loss"
min = 35.0
max = 35.0

[outputs.adjusted_air_demand_m3_min]
description = "Connected demand after simultaneity and leakage allowance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.compressor_capacity_margin_m3_min]
description = "Selected compressor capacity minus adjusted demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.receiver_storage_runtime_min]
description = "Receiver storage runtime over the declared pressure band"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.compressor_shaft_power_kw]
description = "Compressor shaft power from adjusted air demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.motor_input_power_kw]
description = "Motor input power after motor efficiency"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.motor_size_margin_kw]
description = "Selected motor size minus motor input power"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_current_a]
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 three-phase feeder current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.feeder_voltage_drop_percent]
description = "FEEDER-06-480V-03 voltage drop percentage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.voltage_drop_margin_percent]
description = "Maximum voltage drop minus calculated voltage drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pressure_drop_margin_kpa]
description = "Maximum branch pressure loss minus calculated branch loss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when capacity, motor, voltage-drop, and pressure-loss margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
